nights.title: Orla Gartland
nights.name: Orla Gartland
nights.extract: Orla Joan Gartland is an Irish singer, songwriter and musician. Gartland released her debut studio album, Woman on the Internet, in 2021, which reached number 3 on the Irish album chart, number 1 on the UK Indie Chart, and number 10 on the UK Albums Chart. Her second studio album Everybody Needs a Hero came out in October 2024.

nights.title: Stella Lefty - All Ages (under 16 with adult)
nights.name: Stella Lefty
nights.extract: Stella Lefkofsky, better known by her stage name Stella Lefty, is an American singer-songwriter. Her 2026 country-pop single "Boston" peaked at number two on the US Billboard Hot 100.

nights.title: Pedro Sampaio
nights.name: Pedro Sampaio
nights.extract: Pedro do Espirito Santo Sampaio is a Brazilian singer, music producer and DJ, known for the songs "Sentadão", "Escada do Prédio", with Marina Sena, and "Chama Ela", in partnership with the singer Lexa. He is signed to Warner Music Brasil.

nights.title: Yung Gravy: The Joyrider Tour
nights.name: Yung Gravy
nights.extract: Matthew Raymond Hauri, better known by his stage name Yung Gravy, is an American rapper.

nights.title: Lalah Hathaway
nights.name: Lalah Hathaway
nights.extract: Eulaulah Donyll "Lalah" Hathaway is an American singer-songwriter and music producer. Credited as the "First Daughter of Soul", she is the first-born daughter of musician and soul singer Donny Hathaway.

nights.title: JUNKO YAGAMI: Pop Meets Jazz on Route 66
nights.name: Junko Yagami
nights.extract: Junko Yagami , is a Japanese singer and songwriter from Aichi Prefecture. She has released 25 albums, including six live concert albums, and is a notable figure in Japanese music of the 1970s and 1980s. Since her marriage in 1986, she has also recorded under the name "June Stanley".

nights.title: Michaela Anne
nights.name: Michaela Anne
nights.extract: Michaela Anne is an American musician currently residing in Nashville, Tennessee. Her music incorporates elements of classic country, pop, indie rock, and honky-tonk. She has released four albums to date. Her fourth album, Oh To Be That Free, was released through Yep Roc Records on June 10, 2022.
